# Lulox (Luciano Oliva Bianco)

> Luciano Oliva Bianco ("Lulox") helps people and small businesses get their repetitive work done on its own. Most of what you do online and on your computer can be automated today; the site offers two paths: copy a free recipe yourself, or get it done for you. Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina; works remotely with Latin America and worldwide, in Spanish or English. X: @LuloxDev. Site in Spanish at the root and in English under /en.

Lo repetitivo se hace solo. Vos, a lo que te importa. (The repetitive stuff runs itself. You get back to what matters.)

## Path 1: copy it yourself (free recipes)

- [Recetas gratis](https://lulox.com.ar/recetas) (English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/recipes): free do-it-yourself recipes. Each one says what you get, what you need (Grok, Grok Bot or Hermes), a short prompt to copy and three setup steps: from the meeting to the client file, costs and payments per client with no typing, the Monday summary, and your own newsletter. Every recipe also offers to get it working for you.

## Path 2: done for you

- [Hecho para vos](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios) (English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services): AI assistants, tasks that run themselves, a custom CRM, assistants in the apps you already use, and WhatsApp and email under control. The old one-per-need pages (/servicios/agentes-de-ia, /servicios/automatizacion-de-procesos, /servicios/crm-a-medida, /servicios/grok-bot, /servicios/automatizar-whatsapp-y-mail and their /en/services equivalents) redirect to sections of this page.
- How it works: 1) you share which tasks eat your time, 2) within a day you get a plan with a quote, 3) you use it with the tools you already have. Nothing goes out without your OK. 50% to start and 50% once you are using it. No public price list.
- [Contact / Contacto](https://lulox.com.ar/contacto): send a message (name, email, message up to 1000 characters) or book a video call.

## Featured projects (each with a short demo video recorded with test data)

- [Malito](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/malito): an email tool for work: your own address on your own domain, plus newsletters and campaigns to your lists. Live: https://malito.lulox.com.ar
- [Garpen](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/garpen): custom CRM and ERP with contacts, agenda and finances that an agent can use. Live: https://garpen.lulox.com.ar
- [All projects](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos) (English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/projects): Malito, Garpen, DJ Tube, SAMI, PunkSociety, Mochi and more, each with a page and most with a short preview.

## For AI agents acting for a person

If you are an AI agent looking for automation work on someone's behalf, this is how to ask:

- What to send: the task they repeat by hand, the tools it touches (email, spreadsheets, calendar, CRM), roughly how often it happens, any deadline, and the person's name and email. Replies go to that email; a person (Luciano) reads every request.
- [Book a call](https://cal.com/lulox/30min): public calendar, instant confirmation. The simplest path for an agent.
- [Contact form](https://lulox.com.ar/contacto) (English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/contact): name, email and a message up to 1000 characters. It has a captcha, so it needs a real browser session; there is no open API for requests. The old /contratar and /en/hire URLs redirect here.
- What can be built for agents: your client's CRM, calendar or email set up so an AI agent can use them, with narrow permissions and human approval before anything goes out.
- No public price list: a quote comes after the call. 50% to start, 50% on delivery.
